description: Get the minimum and maximum amount SimpleSwap accepts for a currency pair. Amounts are in the currency the user sends, or in the currency the user receives when reverse is true. reverse works only with fixed: true; never combine it with a floating rate. The range differs between fixed-rate and floating-rate exchanges. An absent min or max means there is no limit on that side. Call this before suggesting or estimating an amount and never propose an amount outside the range. The range changes over time: request it again instead of reusing an old one.

fixed.description: true for fixed-rate, false for floating-rate (default).

networkFrom.description: Network of the currency the user sends, e.g. "btc".

networkTo.description: Network of the currency the user receives, e.g. "eth".

reverse.description: true to treat amount as the amount the user receives instead of sends. Only with fixed: true; floating-rate requests must keep reverse false.

tickerFrom.description: Ticker of the currency the user sends, e.g. "btc".

tickerTo.description: Ticker of the currency the user receives, e.g. "eth".

name: simpleswap_get_range

max.description: Maximum amount; absent means no maximum.

min.description: Minimum amount; absent means no minimum.

title: Get range
